verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official CLI as part of its SDK for converting documents from the command line, with concrete commands such as `datalab convert document.pdf --format html` and `--mode accurate`; a probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. Coverage beyond conversion is not evidenced, missing for 10: CLI coverage of extraction/segmentation/pipelines/form filling, agent-oriented features (e.g. machine-readable output, scripting/auth guidance), and independent hands-on corroboration.
